metadata.attribution: Microsoft Global ML Building Footprints; OSM comparison reference © OpenStreetMap contributors (ODbL).
metadata.overlapPolicy: Conservative polygon edge intersection and polygon containment against cached OSM building geometry; any touching or overlapping ML footprint is excluded. No centroid-only deduplication. This may omit adjacent or slightly displaced real buildings.
metadata.geometryNotes: Original Microsoft polygon coordinates retained for selected bbox-intersecting footprints. Render clipped to the pilot window. No manual infill, OSM identities, surveyed heights or cadastral boundaries are invented.
limitations: ML inference can miss, merge or falsely detect buildings.
Catalogue upload date is not the date of underlying satellite imagery; per-footprint imagery dates are unavailable.
All rendered heights are illustrative 6 m assumptions, even where a separate provider height estimate exists.
Supplementation reduces a public-data gap but does not establish a complete or current building inventory.
